adversarialFindings.description: Moving twelve raster badge images from inlined JavaScript to public static URLs would break offline rendering if any URL, shipped file or service-worker install entry were missing or mismatched.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The final candidate maps all twelve badges to matching same-origin public files, adds the eleven previously absent install-list entries while retaining first-step, and updates both source-contract and cache-harness expectations. The new browser test exercises all twelve offline and checks native dimensions, transparent borders, opaque centres and uncropped containment. Parent-reported focused tests and the complete offline project pass.

adversarialFindings.description: Removing the unsupported movement icon could allow the daily-goal progress element to occupy the decorative grid column or remove the only movement identification.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Existing textual activity labels and history identity remain present. The final CSS explicitly places the progress component in column two, row one, and retains the existing enlarged-text block reflow. Reviewer inspected the 320px enlarged-text screenshot; unit and browser coverage includes Kickbacks and a custom movement without the Activity heart.

adversarialFindings.description: The approved artwork pack contains no Kickbacks-specific movement image, and source screenshots use root-text scaling rather than native browser zoom or physical-device testing.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accept the bounded, explicit limitation: unsupported movements retain their existing names without a misleading heart or invented artwork. No claim of physical-device or native browser-zoom certification is made. This limitation does not change movement logging, historical records, goals, awards or progression.

adversarialFindings.description: A decorative correction could accidentally alter award semantics or clip artwork in shared reward, narrative or Hero surfaces beyond the gallery.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The complete diff changes no achievement definition, evaluator, unlock store, Activity formula, schema, backup contract or version. Global image clipping is removed while the glyph fallback retains its circular treatment. Shared renderer consumers and native-size visual artifacts were inspected; parent-reported focused browser tests cover the changed visual contracts.

retrospective.summary: No unresolved blocking defect was identified in the exact reviewed payload. The candidate preserves original badge source identities and learner-state contracts while adding explicit same-origin offline delivery for the new transparent exports, a documented owner-requested compass replacement and truthful text fallback for unsupported movements. Focused verification reported by the integration agent supports the independent source and artifact inspection. This evidence permits the ordinary exact-candidate hosted certification sequence; it does not certify an untested successor, a changed merge payload or production deployment.
